source.title: A simulation based dataset of faults and events for machine learning in power systems

affiliation: Institute of Electrical Energy Systems, Friedrich-Alexander-Universität Erlangen-Nürnberg (FAU)

sampling.twenty_kv_rule: sample apparent power and reactive-power angle uniformly between 0.95 capacitive and 0.8 inductive

zip_model.scope: balanced steady-state load flow; RMS and EMT unvalidated

rms_zip_model.scope: 20 kV, 50 Hz grid, balanced settled RMS voltage response with zero time constants
rms_zip_model.parameter_basis: Explicit settings tested in FT-35; not paper-derived dynamic parameters
rms_zip_model.validation: FT-35 positive-P/Q diagnostic and FT-36 creation/readback passed; FT-37 six sampled ZIP cases covering both Q signs and six constant-power controls passed; FT-38 actual unified-creator loads passed settled RMS response for seeds 0 (inductive) and 4 (capacitive), with restoration and cleanup
rms_zip_model.limitations: Six sampled cases and two end-to-end seeds only, not the full sampled domain; no transient recovery, nonzero time-constant, frequency-response, other voltage/frequency, unbalanced RMS, EMT or server run_rms_simulation validation; the retained FT-36 load was not simulated

load_model_coefficients.status: available through opt-in load_model=zip; legacy catalog_only grouping retained for compatibility
